completeness.why: All four sites now pass their own enable flag and mode (under their own field names) to getDateWithWeekendRule, which decides whether and how to move the date; the only local expression is getNextDate's `skipWeekend && !noSkipWeekend`, and noSkipWeekend is a variation that exists only at that site, so it may stay there. The template sites' day/date conversion is their own data handling.

interface.why: One explicit enable flag plus the mode is exactly the real variation, with no speculative options and each caller mapping its own weekendSolve/weekendSolveMode field; minor cost is a positional boolean and renaming the existing exported helper rather than adding a wrapper.

disguised_duplication.where: The enable-flag ternaries in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and both createScheduleList branches were removed, not reshaped.
